subject: math
description: Compare equal sides and equal angles to decide whether polygons are regular or irregular.
learningObjectives: Define a regular polygon using equal side lengths and equal angle measures
Compare measured sides and angles to classify polygons as regular or irregular
Distinguish between regularity and the number of sides of a polygon
Use ruler and protractor evidence to justify a polygon classification
Identify common measurement errors when checking regular polygons
prerequisites: Identify polygons by number of sides
Recognize vertices and sides of a polygon
